CustomField.formula:
IF (ISBLANK(Time_Breakfast__c), "",
IF(HOUR(Time_Breakfast__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(Time_Breakfast__c)), TEXT(HOUR(Time_Breakfast__c)-12)) & ":" &
IF (MINUTE(Time_Breakfast__c) < 10, "0" + TEXT(MINUTE(Time_Breakfast__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(Time_Breakfast__c))) &
IF (HOUR(Time_Breakfast__c) < 12, " AM", " PM"))
CustomField.label: Time Breakfast Formula
